title: ASSISTANT MANAGER
jobDescription:
Department Details: BPL QA

Role Summary: In-Process Quality Assurance (IPQA-OSD)

Key Responsibilities: The person with hands on IPQA experience will be considered. • To follow the GMP & GDP practices in daily production activities. • Responsible for Calibration or verification of IPQA instruments. • Performing the in-process Quality checks and cleaning of sampling aids. • Responsible for providing the Line clearance certification. • Online review of batch record at all stages of manufacturing and packing activities. • Sampling of in-process, process validation, cleaning validation, hold time, finished product, stability sample and retention samples. • Review and release / rejection of batch at in-process, intermediate and finished product stages of manufacturing of drug products and ensure the batch release or rejection SAP. • Preparation, review and approval of Process validation/optimization/ Hold time protocol and report. • Responsible for initiation and review of Change control/Deviation/ CAPA • Responsible for Preparation and review of APQR • Responsible for Review and approval of Production & Warehouse SOP's • Responsible for tracking of external calibration of IPQA Instruments • Performing equipment challenge test during process validation and batch execution

title: SENIOR EXECUTIVE
jobDescription:
Role Summary: Adherence to standard operating procedures, Safety, cGMP and EHS requirements. Ensuring adherence to the established HR policies, Standing Orders & other established procedures of the Company. To ensure safe working environment for the employees. Establishing and Propagating EHS Management System awareness. To attend the Safety Committee meetings. Implementation of cGMP. Implementation of energy conservation measures. Imparting training to the below hierarchy level on SOP's, IOP's and Process related aspects to maintain quality and consistency. Preparation of documents & records related to Quality (Deviation reports, change controls, CAPA, etc...) and EHS management systems. Planning and procurement of spares and consumables. Planning and execution of different types of maintenance of equipment and its accessories in co-ordination with users. To ensure smooth running of audits (internal and external) related to Quality and EHS management systems. To ensure all the audit findings are closed within the stipulated time. Reporting of non-conformities, adherence, initiation, and implementation of the corrective/preventive actions as suggested by Quality Assurance. Issue of documents for data entry and recoding related to Calibration and PM. Verification of calibration/PM as described in the SOP's. Preparation of equipment/instrument qualification documents and SOPs. Documentation and data control. Maintenance of records. To coordinate with QA for all the validation, qualification, and Audit preparedness. Data entry in log sheets and checklist as described in the SOP's. Issue of work permits. Planning of different types of maintenance of equipment and its accessories in co-ordination with users. Execution of different types of maintenance of equipment and its accessories in co-ordination with users. To ensure all equipment's and instruments are operated and maintained as per manufacturer's recommendation. Co-ordination of contract services for the equipment's and instruments. Co-ordination for HAZOP study. Issue of gate pass. Inventory management. Creation of purchase request. To acknowledge the receipt of material, service, invoice, etc.... To delegate the roles and responsibilities for the reporting personnel. To set objectives and targets for the reporting personnel. To lead & motivate team members to achieve the set targets. Responsible for CAPEX requirements (Plant and Machinery modifications) with reference to cGMP, safety and productivity improvement needs. Execution of Plant and Machinery modifications. Ensuring all the new Projects and Processes are executed as per agreed upon timelines and Quality. To have Knowledge in creation of roles /trainings & self-leaning in digital platform like (SAP Success factor, learning suite etc..). Creation of standard operating procedures in Procedure module (FileNet software, DMS etc..). Knowledge in handling, trouble shooting of PLC / DCS / MES related hardware & software. Knowledge in handling of clean room applications (EMS, BMS etc..), equipment's & concepts. Planning, Coordination & Execution of HVAC Validation activities and equipment Qualification / Requalification

title: EXECUTIVE
jobDescription:
Role Summary: 1. TO HANDLE INDEPENDENTLY THE PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE, BREAKDOWN MAINTENANCE, CALIBRATION & QUALIFICATION OF LAB RELATED EQUIPMENT’S / INSTRUMENT’S. AMC MAINTENANCE OF CRITICAL EQUIPMENTS. 2. TIMELY MAINTENANCE & RECTIFICATION OF LAB EQUIPMENTS LIKE HVAC, CHILLER, AUTOCLAVE, AREA QUALIFICATION, PRESSURE BALANCING, INCUBATOR, STABILITY CHAMBER, WEIGHING BALANCE, VACUUM OVEN, MUFFLE FURNACE, HUMIDIFIER, DISPENCING BOOTH, DIAPHGRAM VACUUM PUMP, WATER RING VACUUM PUMP, HOT AIR OVEN, BIOSAFETY CABINET, DOOR INTERLOCK SYSTEM, AIR SAMPLER, FOGGER, VFD PROGRAMMING AND ERROR RECTIFICATION, 21CFR MONITORING DEVICE/BMS, FILTER CLEANING BOOTH, CLEAN ROOM EQUIPMENTS, SCRUBBER SYSTEM, FUMEHOOD, PRESSURE INSTRUMENTS TESTING & CERTIFICATION, LIFTS, HAND PALLETS MAINTENANCE. 3. SHOULD HAVE KNOWLEDGE ON QUALITY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM, GDP, DI SYSTEM, QUALIFICATION OF CLEAN ROOMS & EXECUTION, EQUIPMENT IQ, OQ & PQ DOCUMENTATION, TEMPERATURE MAPPING QUALIFICATION. 4. SHOULD HAVE KNOWLEDGE ON CALIBRATION & TO COORDINATE WITH EXTERNAL VENDOR FOR CALIBRATION, TEMPERATURE MAPPING, CLEAN ROOM QUALIFICATION, AREA MODIFICATION, BREAKDOWN MAINTENANCE, AMC PM, EQUIPMENT UPGRADATION. 5. INVENTORY MANAGEMENT, SAP KNOWLEDGE FOR PM ACTIVITY, STOCK, BREAKDOWN ACTIVITY, PRN CREATION, NOTIFICATION CREATION, SERVICE ENTRY, QMS COMPLIANCE. 6. SHOULD WORK IN SHIFTS IF REQUIRED. SHOULD SUPPORT LAB ACTIVITIES DURING CRISIS SITUATIONS. 7. SHOULD HAVE KNOWLEDGE ON EHS & SAFETY COMPLIANCE, WORK PERMIT SYSTEM, FAS SYSTEM, FIRE HYDRANT SYSTEM, WASTE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM. 8. SHOULD HAVE KNOWLEDGE ON CAD DRAWING FOR HVAC FACILITY AND LAYOUT MODIFICATION, AC REFRIGERATION & MAINTENANCE. 9. SHOULD HAVE KNOWLEDGE ON PROJECTS, NEW MODIFICATION BOQ, URS PREPARATION & EXECUTION AND TIMELY PROJECT COMPLETION. 10. SHOULD BE A GOOD TEAM MEMBER TO INDULGE WITH THE TEAM. SHOULD EXECUTE & UPDATE LOGSHEETS, CHECKLISTS ONLINE TRUTHFULLY, ADHERENCE TO SOP’s, cGMP, GLP REQUIREMENTS. 11. SHOULD HAVE KNOWLEDGE ABOUT SOP, IOP, OCP, EOP AS PER QMS REQUIREMENT. REVISION & IMPLEMENTING NEW SOP’S, ONLINE QMS. 12. SHOULD BE ABLE TO FACE AUDIT’s FROM INTERNAL & EXTERNAL AGENCY FOR RELATED WORKS. COMPLETING AUDIT OBSERVATIONS WITHIN TIMELINES, CAPA IMPLEMENTATION.

Key Responsibilities: 1. PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE, BREAKDOWN MAINTENANCE OF LAB EQUIPMENTS & UTILITIES-HVAC, AC, CHILLER. 2. CLEAN ROOM QUALIFICATION, TEMPERATURE MAPPING, EQUIPMENT QUALIFICATION. 3. CALIBRATION OF INSTRUMENTS, RAW DATA & TRACEABILITY CERTIFICATE COMPILATION. 4. HVAC OPERATION, PRESSURE BALANCING, HUMIDITY, TEMPERATURE MAINTENANCE & OVERALL MAINTENANCE. 5. CRITICAL STOCK MAINTENANCE & UTILIZATION, TIMELY PROCUREMENT. 6. MODIFICATION OF LAB AREAS & LAB FACILITY AS PER NEW REQUIREMENT, ASSET MANAGEMENT. 7. QMS COMPLIANCE, GLP, GDP, cGMP & ONLINE DMS IN TRACKWISE & SAP SUCCESSFACTOR. 8. EHS & SAFETY COMPLIANCE, WASTE MANAGEMENT. 9. COMMERCIAL ACTIVITIES LIKE PRN CREATION, SERVICE INVOICE ACCOUNTING, PRN FOLLOWUP WITH COMMERCIAL TEAM, FOLLOWUP OF PROCURED ITEMS STILL QUALIFICATION COMPLETION AND SUPPORTING USER DEPARTMENT FOR PROJECT COMPLETION. 10. UPGRADING AGED & CRITICAL EQUIPMENTS TO INCREASE THE LIFESPAN AND TO REDUCE DOWNTIME. PLANNING REPLACEMENT OF CRITICAL SPARES & CONSUMABLES. 11.HANDLING AMC OF EQUIPMENTS FOR PM, VALIDATION, CALIBRATION, BILLS ACCOUNTING, TIMELY RENEWAL OF AMC.
